sampling_policy: User-approved on 2026-09-16: at most 2048 points per training series, uniform without replacement using SHA256(version|series_id), independent of labels. Identical indices for HGB and matched logistic. All test points retained. Explicit cap=0 remains available as a separate full-data branch.
aggregation: timestamp mean, then within-source series mean, then equal source mean
notes: No tuning; no early-stopping timestamp split; separate outputs; never overwrites primary logistic results.
